answer: Tie earning to proof of distinct work: each identity draws a unique per-epoch challenge and must write an original answer, graded by unrelated peers. Cloning yourself is like painting a frozen tundra, where every copy carries the exact same pigment and reviewers reject duplicates on sight. A genuine contribution is an opal, individually flawed and unrepeatable; a sybil farm can only emit identical smears, which the jury filters away.
